parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is a glass pane section of the window, likely one of the movable panels.
parts.Functional_description: It allows light to pass through while providing a barrier to air and moisture. It can slide or translate within the window frame.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the frame track for opening or closing.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is another glass pane section of the window, similar to the first one.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a transparent barrier and can slide horizontally to adjust ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally within the window frame track.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is a third glass pane section of the window.
parts.Functional_description: It provides light transmission and insulation, and can be moved for ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally within the frame.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth glass pane section of the window.
parts.Functional_description: It completes the set of movable panels, allowing flexible control of airflow and light.
parts.Movement_description: It translates horizontally along the window track.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the window, made of aluminum for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and holds the glass panels in place, providing structural integrity and guiding the movement of the sliding panes.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the base structure for the window assembly.
